lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately 5-6 horizontal rows with a semi-regular periodicity of 12-15 centroids per row in the visible mid-section, oriented posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows, forming a checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients consisting of high-intensity upper margins and shadowed lower margins running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 8 discrete high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration toward the anterior and basal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 12 elongated, dark-toned objects is located in the water column directly below the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral flank.
